figurative_meaning_en: Extraordinarily skilled or powerful; exceptionally capable
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একাই একশ, সব কাজ নিজে করে ফেলে।
আমার ভাই একাই একশ, পরিবারের সব দায়িত্ব সামলায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is one alone equals a hundred; he handles all the tasks by himself.
My brother is one alone equals a hundred; he manages all family responsibilities.
note: This idiom emphasizes individual prowess in Bengali folklore and daily expressions.
